item.title: Better Auth 1.7 Ships a Standards-Based OAuth Server
item.description: A major OAuth and OpenID Connect expansion, updated MCP authorization, SCIM Groups and role projections, unified identity, device authorization, and more. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: SVGO 4.1: Node-Powered SVG Optimizer
item.description: SVGO is a Node.js library and command-line application for optimizing vector images. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: GTKX: Build Linux Desktop Apps with Node, GTK and React
item.description: Write declarative JSX. GTKX renders it to GObject instances, powered by a native Rust core. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: Outgrowing Cron? Meet xyOps for Self-Hosted Ops Automation
item.description: Built by the creator of Cronicle, xyOps combines fleet job scheduling, visual workflows, server monitoring, contextual alerts, snapshots, tickets, and incident response in one fully open-source, self-hosted platform. (1 source: nodeweekly)
